description:
Returns a single webhook subscription. The signing secret is never included.

Endpoint: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/webhooks/{webhook_id}

account_id.description: Your own account, or an account you provisioned. It — not the credential, and not the `BeeL-Active-Company` header — decides which account the operation acts on. An account you do not reach answers `403`, and so does an account that does not exist, so the existence of somebody else's account is never disclosed.

webhook_id.description: Subscription of the account in the path. A subscription of another account answers `404`, the same as one that does not exist: under the account resolved from `{account_id}` it simply is not there.

name: beel_get_webhook_subscription
